title.description: Header title of one game's leaderboard screen.
title.notes: {{game}} is the translated game name, e.g. Sudoku.

column.rank.description: Column header for the rank position. A symbol or very short word.

column.player.description: Column header for the player's display name.

column.date.description: Column header for the date the entry was set.

metric.score.description: Column header for a board ranked by points.

metric.moves.description: Column header for a board ranked by moves (fewest wins, e.g. FreeCell).

metric.level.description: Column header for a board ranked by the highest level solved (Sort Puzzle).

direction.asc.description: Caption on boards where the lowest number ranks first (e.g. fewest moves).

partition.tier.description: Label of the Star Swarm difficulty-tier picker above the board.

you.description: Tag next to the player's own name in the list.

yourBest.description: Label above the player's own best entry, pinned below the list when they are outside it.

empty.description: Shown when a board has no entries yet.

error.description: Shown when the board could not be loaded (server error).

offline.description: Shown when the device is offline; the board loads again on reconnect.

retry.description: Button that loads the board again.

unavailable.description: Shown if a game without a leaderboard is opened.

a11y.row.description: Screen-reader label for one row of the board.
a11y.row.notes: Screen-reader label for one row. {{rank}} is a 1-based position, {{name}} the player's display name, {{metric}} the translated metric label (Score, Moves, Level), {{value}} the number, {{date}} a localised short date.

a11y.rowYou.description: Screen-reader label for the player's own row of the board.
a11y.rowYou.notes: Screen-reader label for one row. {{rank}} is a 1-based position, {{name}} the player's display name, {{metric}} the translated metric label (Score, Moves, Level), {{value}} the number, {{date}} a localised short date.

a11y.yourBest.description: Screen-reader label for the player's pinned best entry.
a11y.yourBest.notes: Screen-reader label for one row. {{rank}} is a 1-based position, {{name}} the player's display name, {{metric}} the translated metric label (Score, Moves, Level), {{value}} the number, {{date}} a localised short date.

a11y.back.description: Screen-reader label of the header's back button, which returns to the game.
a11y.back.notes: {{game}} is the translated game name, e.g. Sudoku.
